title: The 8 Best Doorway Pull-Up Bars
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for doorway pull-up bars, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at doorway pull-up bars using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Iron Gym Total Upper Body Workout Bar - Extreme Edition
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 grip positions (narrow, neutral, wide, alternate wide, side), No-screw leverage mount, Fits doorways 24 to 32 inches.
strengths: Widest grip variety of any bar in this list at five positions
Setup and removal takes under a minute with no tools
Doubles as a full floor-based bodyweight station, not just a hanging bar
limitations: Foam grips wear and compress after a year or two of daily use
Only fits doorways up to 32 inches, too narrow for some modern door casings
Padded arms can mark softer trim without a towel underneath
features: 5 grip positions (narrow, neutral, wide, alternate wide, side)
Doubles as a push-up, sit-up, and dip station on the floor

products.name: ProsourceFit Multi-Grip Chin-Up/Pull-Up Bar
products.blurb: Key specs: 12 grip positions, Heavy-gauge steel frame, Fits doorways 24 to 36 inches.
strengths: 12 grip positions is the most of any barhere, useful for hammer, close, and wide-grip work
Fits wider doorways up to 36 inches, covering more modern homes
Limited lifetime warranty is rare at this price point
limitations: Longer bar means it protrudes further into the doorway walkway
Some users need to reposition it slightly for a truly centered pull
Foam grips are firmer than Iron Gym's, less comfortable on long sets

products.name: Perfect Fitness Multi-Gym Doorway Pull Up Bar
products.blurb: Key specs: 3 padded grip positions (normal, wide, hammer), Fits door frames up to 33 inches wide, 6 inches deep, 300-pound rated capacity.
strengths: Rotating padded handles are noticeably more comfortable on the wrists during hammer-grip pulls
Genuinely useful as a floor-based multi-gym, not just a hanging bar
Compact and light enough to travel with or store easily
limitations: Only 3 grip positions versus the 5 to 12 offered by competitors
6-inch trim depth requirement rules out some thinner door casings
Assembly of the floor accessories takes longer than a simple bar-only setup
features: Fits door frames up to 33 inches wide, 6 inches deep
Converts to a floor unit for push-ups, dips, and sit-ups

products.name: Yes4All Doorway Pull Up Bar (24-34 Inch)
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits doorways 24 to 34 inches, 200-pound rated capacity, No-screw leverage mount.
strengths: Fast no-tool setup and takedown
Wide 24 to 34 inch fit range covers most standard residential doorways
limitations: 200-pound capacity is lower than most competitors here, a real limit for heavier users
Grip padding is thinner and wears faster than pricier options
Only one usable hand position on some doorway widths due to bar length

products.name: Yes4All Heavy Duty Doorway Pull Up Bar (300 lb)
products.blurb: Key specs: Fits doorways 30 to 38 inches, 300-pound rated capacity, Multi-grip foam handles.
strengths: 300-pound rating at a budget price, a step up from Yes4All's base model
Fits wider doorways (30 to 38 inches) than most bars in this list
Reinforced construction feels noticeably sturdier under load than the base Yes4All bar
limitations: Minimum 30-inch doorway requirement rules out narrower older-home frames
Only 2 practical grip positions given the bar's length
Slightly bulkier to store than the compact base model

products.name: Stamina Doorway Pull-Up Bar Trainer
products.blurb: Key specs: 12 grip options, 250-pound rated capacity, Thick non-slip foam grips.
strengths: Extra-thick foam padding is noticeably easier on the hands over long sets
12 grip options rival the ProsourceFit for variety
No hardware installation, removes and reattaches quickly
limitations: 250-pound capacity sits below the 300-pound bars in this list
Fewer total ratings than the market leaders, less long-term data
Frame flexes slightly more than steel-heavy competitors under fast reps

products.name: Garren Fitness Maximiza Doorway Pull-Up Bar
strengths: Rated to 300 lb
Screw-in mounts for security
Simple, strong design
Fits most standard doorways
limitations: Requires drilling into the frame
Needs solid wood trim
Not removable without unscrewing

products.name: Garren Fitness Maximiza Plus Pull-Up Bar (Wide Doorways)
strengths: Fits wide doorways
330 lb rating
Screw-mounted stability
Simple design
limitations: Requires drilling

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
